ValidationRule.description: Validation rule to make the fields Account and Contact mandatory to some BUs
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), NOT(CONTAINS($User.Alias, 'ssyst')), NOT(CONTAINS(RecordType.Name, 'User')), ISBLANK(AccountId), ISBLANK(ContactId), ISBLANK(CreatedById ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Owner:User.ER_Business_Unit__c,'FI')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Owner:User.ER_Business_Unit__c,'SE')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Owner:User.ER_Business_Unit__c,'ES')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You have to fill the "Account Name" and "Contact Name" fields
